clubs.tacticsWhy: Based on my own totals from ESPN team stats for the 6 completed league matches. Average possession is 52.5% (65–69% in the three home wins/draws vs Sevilla, Elche and Alavés; 30–46% away at Barcelona, Celta and at home to Atlético). The pressing proxy (opponent passes ÷ Athletic's tackles + interceptions + fouls, whole pitch, not true PPDA) averages 13.5. That is about the same as Atlético, but it is 6.8–10.6 in the home matches. Opponents were caught offside about 3.5 times per game (21 in 6, including 8 by Barcelona), as often as against Barcelona, which points to a high line: line 4. Press 4 rather than 3 is a judgement from that high line and the home figures. Accurate crosses average 5.0 per game, the most of the four clubs, and Fichajes names Areso and Yuri as the main flank options: width 4. Accurate long balls are 5.6% of accurate passes (137/2451), so passing 3. Tempo 3 and style 'normal' are judgements (7 goals for, 6 against in 6). I found no source on set pieces, so setAtt and setDef are placeholders.
clubs.desc: Athletic Club spiller 4-2-3-1 med fart på kanterne og offensive backer, presser aktivt og holder en høj forsvarslinje, hvorfra holdet ofte søger indlæg i feltet.

clubs.tacticsWhy: Based on my own totals from ESPN team stats for the 8 league matches. Average possession is 51.8% (range 39–63%). It was 39% in the 2-1 derby loss at Atlético and 46% vs Villarreal. I built a pressing proxy: opponent passes divided by Madrid's tackles + interceptions + fouls, over the whole pitch, so it is not true PPDA. It averages about 18.9 across 7 matches, the most passive of the four clubs (Barcelona about 10.1). Goal's tactics-board piece on the Villarreal match says the same: a 4-2-3-1 that drops into a 4-4-2 mid-block, no high press, engaging only in the middle third, then 'contain and counter' with deep balls from Alexander-Arnold and runs from Mbappé. That gives press 2, line 3 and tempo 4. Opponents were caught offside about 1.3 times per game, so the line is mid rather than high. Accurate long balls are 5.8% of accurate passes (185/3181), so passing 3. Accurate crosses average 4.4 per game, so width 3. Style 'normal' is my judgement: 19 goals for and 8 against in 8 matches, and the team keeps a defensive structure. I found no source on set pieces, so setAtt and setDef are placeholders.
clubs.desc: Real Madrid stiller op i 4-2-3-1, forsvarer i en kompakt mellemblok uden højt pres og søger hurtigt og direkte frem i omstillingerne, gerne med lange bolde i dybden.

Vinícius Júnior (7 of 8 starts) was on the bench, came on and was sent off (72'/74', for pulling Saliba's hair), and may be suspended for the next matches. Dumfries has started 5 of 8 at RB against 3 for Alexander-Arnold.
Wide roles move around. In earlier matches ESPN listed Diomande as right attacking midfielder and Vinícius as left. Against Villarreal ESPN listed Güler on the right and Diomande on the left.

Left and right for the centre-backs (Konaté RCB, Rüdiger LCB) and holding midfielders (Valverde RDM, Tchouaméni LDM) come from ESPN shot-map labels (Konaté 'Center Right Defender', Tchouaméni 'Left Midfielder') and the page order. ESPN does not label every position.
Away kit colour: sources say only 'dark green' (with off-white details). The hex is approximate.
Some search snippets said Asencio, Militão, Rodrygo and Mendy were injured before the Villarreal match. I did not open those pages.
